response.sql: WITH rentals_by_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_rentals FROM rentals_by_rating), above_avg_only AS (SELECT rental_count FROM rentals_by_rating WHERE rental_count > (SELECT avg_rentals FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_figure, AVG(rental_count) - (SELECT avg_rentals FROM overall_avg) AS distance_above_overall_average FROM above_avg_only
